title: Maximum Area of Longest Diagonal Rectangle
summary: Given a list of rectangles defined by their dimensions, calculate the area of the rectangle with the longest diagonal.
statement: Given a list of rectangles defined by their dimensions, calculate the area of the rectangle with the longest diagonal. If multiple rectangles have the same longest diagonal, return the area of the one with the largest area.
constraints: Choose a rectangle with the greatest diagonal length; compare squared diagonals to avoid square roots.
If diagonals tie, choose the greatest area; return that area.
hints: Squared diagonal length preserves diagonal ordering without floating-point error.
Use a pair key of squared diagonal followed by area.
Select the maximum rectangle under that key and return its area.
Lexicographic maximization implements the primary diagonal rule and then exactly the required tie-break.
editorial: Lexicographic maximization implements the primary diagonal rule and then exactly the required tie-break.
